name: Chosen

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has a Mark of Chaos (W&G p.136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G p.75)

abilities.text: Chosen frequently carry a wide array of weapons, including combi-flamer, combi-plasma, and combi-melta guns, power fists, and plasma pistols.
They are also armed with Frag and Krak Grenades.

abilities.name: Wanton Slaughter
abilities.text: When a Chosen successfully hits with a Wrath Critical in melee they deal +2 Mortal Wounds.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round

options.name: Chosen Champion
options.text: A Chosen Champion leads a band of Legionaries. They have the following wargear and Ruin action.

abilities.name: Death to the False Emperor!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to Charge, gaining +2 bonus dice to the attack Test.

note: Print errors copied as printed: skill 'Intimitation' (Intimidation), trait 'Superchange' (Supercharge) and 'Unweildy (2)' (Unweildy printed; Unwieldy). Printed with an 'Or,' between Chainsword and Boltgun.
